hypothesis: After the failover, the Connect offsets of pg-orders-connector were not copied to the new worker, so task 0 asks for slot debezium_orders at a stale LSN; restart the connector.

verdict.reason: The hypothesis blames Connect offsets that were not copied and a stale LSN, and it proposes a plain restart. It never says the slot itself is missing on the new primary, so the root cause is wrong and is placed in kafka-connect rather than postgres, although the first failing layer it implies (kafka-connect task) matches.
